title: Gene expression data of patients with medulloblastoma from whole-genome sequencing
author: Lee, Yeonghun
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from fresh frozen medulloblastoma tissues using the Maxwell RSC RNA FFPE Kit (Promega, Madison, WI, USA).

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq library
steps.instruction: Prepare the RNA‑seq library with the SureSelectXT RNA Direct Library Kit (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA, USA).

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq6000
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq6000 platform to obtain paired‑end reads of 101 bp.

steps.title: Map reads and quantify expression
steps.instruction: Map the paired‑end reads to the GRCh37 reference genome using STAR, then quantify gene expression levels with Cufflinks.

substeps.instruction: Map reads to GRCh37 with STAR.
